title: Session activity
description: What one MLS application message in a session carries (protocol draft, section 5): one ActivityStreams activity in UTF-8 JSON, read as plain JSON (no JSON-LD expansion). Unknown terms are ignored. This is what a sender must produce; readers are lenient where noted: a malformed channel files the note under story, a malformed clock reads as 0-0000, and activities of other types, or about notes they can't find, are discarded.

type.description: Read, View and Listen are never sent; readers discard them.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock: milliseconds, hyphen, 4-digit counter (ordering-clock.json).

authorSeq.description: Counts the sending device's activities in the session, from 1; a gap means a missing message.

then.description: Naming or describing a channel: the activity's channel, when given, is the channel's own name.

channelName.description: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9 and single inner hyphens, never folded (names.json).

note.description: A note. For Update, id is the note being changed and content its new text; only its author's updates count.

content.description: Markdown; readers sanitize anything rendered from it.

inReplyTo.description: The id of the note it answers, in any channel.

channel.description: Names a channel (Create) or describes it again (Update); every description is kept, and channels are never deleted.
